topography.project_purpose: BIMA CDP is a decentralized borrowing protocol that allows users to deposit collateral and mint a stablecoin (DebtToken) across multiple chains. It includes liquidation mechanisms, stability pools, and governance features to maintain the peg and manage risk.
topography.relationship_narrative: The CDP family relies on Price Oracles for collateral valuation and Cross-Chain Assets as collateral types. BIMA Token & Governance controls protocol parameters and incentives, while Stability Mechanisms and Yield & Strategies support peg stability and capital efficiency.
